patch_description: The current program (score 0.19) relies on softmin-gradient ascent which stalls in poor basins, while the best prior program (score 0.81) used exact-ratio hill climbing seeded by a fast gradient funnel. Key parameters that drove that success: exact `_ratio` hill climbing (not smooth surrogate), a broad deterministic seed set (~72 inits), gradient ascent with annealed sharpness p=40+2*it, and staged polish. My new design strengthens the proven winners: (1) keep the vectorized softmin gradient funnel but raise sharpness to p=60+3*it and 350 iters for better funneling; (2) expand the polish pool from top-12 to top-14 candidates; (3) implement the recommended multi-elite basin hopping — for each of the top-3 elites run 8 deterministic perturbations with amplitudes drawn from a ladder (0.008–0.06), each followed by a medium climb, plus perturbing the 2nd and 3rd-ranked candidates, not only the best; (4) final long polish (8000 iters, amp starting at 0.015 with adaptive growth on success up to 0.08 and shrink on 60 failures); (5) hull scaling moves in the final polish to counteract hull shrinkage. All randomness via fixed seeds for determinism; total budget tuned to ~20s.
